name: WE-MD benchmark
description: WE-MD benchmark evaluates molecular dynamics methods for proteins, including machine-learned dynamics, using standardized enhanced-sampling analysis and validation of rare conformational states. It aims to make comparisons between simulation approaches reproducible and objective.
evaluation_method: Weighted ensemble simulation analysis using WESTPA with TICA-derived progress coordinates; evaluates sampling efficiency, rare-state visitation, convergence, and agreement with standardized reference analyses.
general_score_metric: sampling efficiency and rare-state validation score
notes: Designed as a modular framework for validating protein MD methods, especially those using enhanced sampling and machine-learned dynamics. The source metadata does not specify a fixed item count or a canonical SOTA score.
